scope: Whole distance policies 0.68.0 versus 0.69.0, same visual settings and timed camera path; not identical geometry.

method.camera: Fixed -66,80,-99 for 60+20 s, then 195 blocks west and 36 south over 40 s with gentle scripted yaw.
notes: Real Game.update/render with scripted input and a fresh isolated world; no installed saves.
Same harness, seed, settings and timed camera path against both source trees.
This compares the complete distance policy, NOT equal chunk sets or equal geometry.
Streaming remains active throughout; no reception cap or mesh pause.
Fixed stationary sample starts after 60 s regardless of readiness; unfinished queues are reported.
Steady state requires empty near load/mesh queues and zero missing, requested or transitioning far tiles for 3 s.
Audio, meteors and hand disabled; time .25 and plant growth frozen in both runs.
CPU closes the previous RAF interval; asynchronous GPU samples cannot be added to CPU time.
Draw counters include all passes; near/far CPU geometry buffers are not measured VRAM.
Visual-only camera poses follow the timed phases and do not count towards performance comparisons.
Guards: 6500 MiB JavaScript heap or 420 s; guards do not demonstrate full-distance completion.

CPU geometry bytes include near and cached far buffers; these are not VRAM.
Visual-only phases are excluded from performance comparisons.

Near/far overlap has no missing pixels

Pending far replacement retains every detailed pixel
Missing near mesh leaves the far representation intact

WebGL1 fallback context is available
WebGL1 uses the same ready transition without invalid texture formats or holes
WebGL1 mask updates preserve pending detailed coverage
Terrain contains no empty or plant groups
Plants contain only nonempty plant groups

acceptance.visualReview: Manual observations and limitations are recorded separately in WYNIKI.md.

caveats: The fixed stationary phase can still be streaming; its before/after readiness is part of the evidence.
Guarded or timed-out runs must not be described as complete-distance steady state.
Geometry bytes count unique CPU typed-array buffers of near and cached far meshes, not VRAM or every auxiliary allocation.
Recorded CPU and GPU times overlap and must not be added together.
Log fingerprints identify the coordinator-verified validation files; this script does not infer process exit status from console text.
Screenshot hashes establish provenance; appearance still requires an explicit visual review.
Raw frame arrays and isolated browser profiles remain outside the public compact evidence.
